The '''RH-34 Starforged assault cannon''' was a type of portable [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] produced during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:CM" />

The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Nil'Duru]] used one in combat on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] during the [[Mission to Copero|events]] of the [[Order of Zildrog campaign]].<ref name="TOR:ATAtC">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref> During the [[Third Galactic War]], the [[Republic trooper]] [[Godol]] used a RH-34 Starforged assault cannon during the [[Invasion of Manaan]]<ref name="TOR:Restoration">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|Restoration|Manaan}}</ref> as well as [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bodan Siraam]].<ref name="TOR:Fallout">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=heroic|Fallout|Manaan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The RH-34 Starforged assault cannon was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Apprentice's Shadow Pack.<ref name="TOR:3.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2122015/game-update-3.1-conflict-rishi|text=Game Update 3.1: Conflict On Rishi}}</ref>
